title: Get help for Bash builtin commands
summary: Use the `help` command to see documentation for built-in Bash commands like `cd`, `for`, or `while`. This is useful when you need a quick reminder of syntax without opening a manual.

steps.explain: Run `help` to list all available built-in commands.
Run `help <command>` to get specific instructions for a built-in command like `cd`, `for`, or `while`.

placeholders.name: COMMAND
placeholders.description: The name of the Bash built-in command you want help with.
